verdict.rationale: FreeAgent publishes static developer docs, a quick start, curl guidance and a sandbox API. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference where examples can be run in the browser. The 'Exchange Authorization Code for Tokens' step only covers getting OAuth tokens, and the sandbox is a separate test environment, not runnable docs. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so no spec-driven interactive explorer is evidenced either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
